title: A Gerudo Guard Finds a Cute Hylian (Video (Standard))
description: A Gerudo warrior stands guard in front of Gerudo Town. She’s bored, and humming to herself until a cute Hylian Vai dressed in Gerudo silks comes wandering out of the desert. After drinking just a bit too much ale at the town bar, the Gerudo guard offers a place to sleep it off which the Hylian gleefully accepts. "The Gerudo are famed for their strength after all, come on, cutie, just let me carry you home like the prize you are. You look even cuter cradled in my arms! I want to show you just how cute I think you really are. My love, will you show me your Mastersword?"
author: Mistress Shibby
